g.text: Initial Methodological Blueprint · Multi-Factor Residualization · Continuous Causal Discovery · Regime Breaks · Contagion-Pruned Alpha

svg.text: PHASE I · SYSTEMATIC FACTOR ORTHOGONALIZATION (FEEDBACK A)

g.text: Simultaneous ingestion of equity return series and systemic risk factors.
Daily asset price and return panel spanning primary GICS sectors.
Tech, Financials, Healthcare, Consumer, Industrial, Energy
Problem: Raw correlation confounds firm links with market co-movement.
Exogenous macro controls capturing broad cross-sectional variance.
"Residualize returns on Fama-French factors before learning graph."
R_{i,t} - R_{f,t} = α_i + β_i^T F_t + ε_{i,t}, Cov(ε_{i,t}, F_t) = 0
• Regress cross-sectional asset returns against market, size, and value.
• Extract residual innovations ε_{i,t} strictly independent of systematic beta.
• Residual graph captures true economic interconnectedness, not market tides.
Guarantees graph edges represent genuine transmission channels.
Standard financial networks suffer from dense pseudo-edges because
a rising tide lifts all assets. By stripping systematic factor returns:
• Surviving edges represent genuine inter-firm causal risk.
• Residual correlation drops significantly, unmasking topology.
• Establishes pristine input for non-linear causal discovery.

svg.text: PHASE II · CAUSAL DISCOVERY & BENCHMARK AUDIT (FEEDBACK B)

g.text: Inverse covariance estimator encoding conditional Gaussian independence.
min_{Θ≻0} { tr(SΘ) - ln det(Θ) + α ||Θ||_{1, off} }
• Undirected Gaussian conditional independence topology (Θ = Σ^-1).
• Enforces strict edge symmetry: Θ_{ij} = Θ_{ji} (No causal directionality).
• Assumes normality; misses asymmetric shock propagation & fat tails.
Continuous non-linear causal discovery with log-det acyclicity constraint.
h(W) = -ln det(sI - W ∘ W) + d ln s = 0 (Exact Acyclicity)
• Student-t Log-Likelihood loss accommodates heavy tails (degrees of freedom ν).
• Simultaneous estimation of contemporaneous (W) and lagged (A) directed graphs.
• Neural MLP equations capture complex non-linear financial interactions.
Discovers true directed transmitters of volatility shocks across network.
"Reframe as empirical non-redundancy — benchmark against precision matrix."
Collinearity Audit: Target VIF < 5.0 Across All Graph Features
Empirically validates DAGMA captures unique asymmetric causality.
Softens mathematical claims to empirical evidence per instructor feedback (b).

svg.text: PHASE III · REGIME BREAK TRACKING & CATBOOST FUSION

g.text: Monitors dynamic topological dislocation across rolling DAGMA windows.
• Roll 60-day window to compute continuous topological velocity vector ΔW_t.
• Calibrate empirical threshold τ_crit (e.g. 95th percentile historical dislocation).
• Detect systemic regime shifts prior to market-wide volatility explosions.
Flags institutional balance sheet stress ahead of price declines.
Chronological forecasting of next-day forward volatility (σ_{i, t+1}).
• Strict walk-forward out-of-sample splits preventing lookahead bias.
• Feature ablation protocol: quantify marginal gain of causal features.
• Symmetric tree splitting handles complex tabular interactions robustly.
Outputs dynamic asset-level volatility forecasts for risk targeting.
Combines continuous network topology with gradient boosted decision trees to test:
• Do DAGMA causal features improve volatility prediction RMSE?
• Does structural break tracking provide lead-time on crash risk?
• How do causal features rank against classical momentum & vol?

svg.text: PHASE IV · STRATEGY EXECUTION & BENCHMARK EVALUATION

g.text: Topological hub elimination during regime breaks with causal drift ratchet.
1. Hub Pruning: Zero out top-2 out-degree nodes (k_out = ∑_j |W_ij|)
2. Causal Ratchet: Tighten stops as Frobenius drift ΔW_t expands
3. Re-Entry Filter: Price confirmation P_t > MA_20 & Positive Momentum
Participates uninhibited during sustained bull regimes while rapidly
rotating to cash upon structural contagion detection.
Engineered to solve the classical buy-and-hold drawdown vulnerability.
Rigorous comparative benchmark protocol across 4 investment models.
• Risk-Adjusted Return: Annualized Return, Sharpe Ratio, Information Ratio.
• Tail-Risk Mitigation: Maximum Drawdown (MaxDD), Calmar Ratio, CVaR 95%.
• Real-World Friction: Turnover analysis & transaction cost drag (5–15 bps).
• Fig 1: Factor residualization audit (variance explained & correlation drop)
• Fig 2: Precision matrix vs. DAGMA directed topology comparison
• Fig 3: Empirical orthogonality & collinearity VIF validation audit
• Fig 4: Structural break timeline & rolling Frobenius causal drift (ΔW_t)
• Fig 5: CatBoost feature importance & chronological ablation scorecard
• Fig 6: Out-of-sample equity curve & underwater drawdown comparison
Research Hypothesis: Causal Pruning significantly mitigates tail drawdown
while achieving superior risk-adjusted return over Buy & Hold.
